pyiceberg:position-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. PyIceberg's only delete/update mode is copy-on-write; it never produces position delete files. It can read position delete files, but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: reads position delete files

pyiceberg:position-deletes:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. PyIceberg's only delete/update mode is copy-on-write; it never produces deletion vectors. It can read V3 deletion vectors (added in v0.10.0), but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: reads V3 deletion vectors (v0.10.0+)

pyiceberg:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported for reads or writes. PyIceberg never writes equality delete files and raises ValueError / NotImplementedError when scanning tables that contain them.
caveats: Cannot read or write equality delete files

pyiceberg:equality-deletes:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not support equality deletes in V3
caveats: Equality deletes not supported in any format version

pyiceberg:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. All of PyIceberg's deletes use copy-on-write; it cannot write merge-on-read deletes. It can read tables with position delete files (not equality deletes), but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: reads position delete files (equality deletes are not supported)

pyiceberg:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. All of PyIceberg's deletes use copy-on-write; it cannot write merge-on-read deletes. It can read V3 deletion vectors (added in v0.10.0), but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: reads V3 deletion vectors (v0.10.0+)

pyiceberg:copy-on-write:v2.notes: Copy-on-write is PyIceberg's default and only delete/update mode; data files are rewritten without deleted rows

pyiceberg:copy-on-write:v3.notes: Writing V3 data/manifests is not yet supported in PyIceberg 0.12.0 (write_manifest raises ValueError for format version 3).
caveats: V3 data writes are not yet supported (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:schema-evolution:v2.notes: Full schema evolution support via update_schema() context manager: add, drop, rename, reorder columns, widen types, and union_by_name

pyiceberg:schema-evolution:v3.notes: Metadata-only schema evolution via update_schema() works against REST catalogs (where the server serializes V3 metadata), but fails on non-REST catalogs where TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json() raises NotImplementedError.
caveats: REST catalog only; client-side catalogs raise NotImplementedError when writing V3 metadata

pyiceberg:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values are a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:column-default-values:v3.notes: PyIceberg parses and preserves initial-default and write-default on schema fields, so tables with column defaults can be read and their metadata round-trips correctly. Writing data that applies defaults is pending V3 write support.
caveats: Read/metadata support only; defaults are not applied when writing data

pyiceberg:table-creation:v2.notes: Full table creation support via catalog.create_table() with Iceberg or PyArrow schemas, partition specs, sort orders, and table properties

pyiceberg:table-creation:v3.notes: Creating an empty V3 table works only via a REST catalog (server-side metadata serialization). Non-REST catalogs raise NotImplementedError in TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json().
caveats: REST catalog only; non-REST catalogs raise NotImplementedError on V3 table creation (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: PyIceberg supports hidden partitioning with identity, bucket, truncate, year, month, day, hour transforms; bucket and truncate write support added in v0.9.0 via iceberg-rust

pyiceberg:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: Reads hidden-partitioned V3 tables written by other engines; cannot write V3 data files or manifests.
caveats: Read-only on V3 tables; V3 data writes are not yet supported (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:partition-evolution:v2.notes: Full partition evolution support via update_spec() context manager

pyiceberg:partition-evolution:v3.notes: Metadata-only partition evolution via update_spec() works against REST catalogs, but fails on non-REST catalogs where TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json() raises NotImplementedError.
caveats: REST catalog only; client-side catalogs raise NotImplementedError when writing V3 metadata

pyiceberg:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument transforms are a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not yet support multi-argument transforms
caveats: Not yet implemented

pyiceberg:time-travel:v2.notes: Full time travel support via scan(snapshot_id=...) and table.inspect methods with snapshot_id parameter

pyiceberg:table-maintenance:v2.notes: PyIceberg supports expire_snapshots, manage_snapshots, and old metadata file cleanup (write.metadata.delete-after-commit.enabled); does not support data compaction, manifest rewriting, or orphan file cleanup
caveats: No data file compaction
No manifest rewriting
No orphan file cleanup

pyiceberg:table-maintenance:v3.notes: Same table maintenance limitations as V2, and metadata commits on V3 tables work only via REST catalogs (non-REST catalogs raise NotImplementedError in TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json()).
caveats: REST catalog only for V3 metadata updates
No data file compaction
No manifest rewriting
No orphan file cleanup

pyiceberg:branching-tagging:v2.notes: Full branching and tagging support via manage_snapshots() API: create_branch, create_tag, with configurable retention policies

pyiceberg:branching-tagging:v3.notes: Branching and tagging via manage_snapshots() works against REST catalogs, but fails on non-REST catalogs where TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json() raises NotImplementedError.
caveats: REST catalog only; client-side catalogs raise NotImplementedError when writing V3 metadata

pyiceberg:read-support:v2.notes: Full read support via scan().to_arrow(), to_pandas(), to_duckdb(), to_ray(), to_polars(), to_daft(), and to_bodo(); supports row filters, column projection, and streaming via to_arrow_batch_reader()
caveats: Cannot read tables containing equality delete files

pyiceberg:read-support:v3.notes: V3 read support including deletion vectors (added in v0.10.0) and nanosecond timestamps
caveats: Cannot read tables containing equality delete files

pyiceberg:write-insert:v2.notes: Full insert support via append(), overwrite(), and dynamic_partition_overwrite() using PyArrow tables

pyiceberg:write-insert:v3.notes: Writing V3 data/manifests is not yet supported in PyIceberg 0.12.0 (write_manifest raises ValueError for format version 3).
caveats: V3 data writes are not yet supported (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:write-merge-update-delete:v2.notes: PyIceberg supports delete(filter), overwrite(filter), and upsert() operations via programmatic API; no SQL MERGE/UPDATE/DELETE syntax
caveats: Programmatic API only, no SQL syntax
Deletes use copy-on-write (can be slow for large tables)
Upsert requires identifier fields to be defined

pyiceberg:write-merge-update-delete:v3.notes: Writing V3 data/manifests is not yet supported in PyIceberg 0.12.0 (write_manifest raises ValueError for format version 3).
caveats: V3 data writes are not yet supported (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Native support for REST, SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite), Hive, Glue, DynamoDB, and BigQuery Metastore catalogs

pyiceberg:catalog-integration:v3.notes: All catalog integrations work with V3 tables

pyiceberg:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: AWS Glue Catalog supported for V3 tables

pyiceberg:rest-catalog:v2.notes: Full Iceberg REST Catalog support with OAuth2, SIGv4 authentication, and bearer token signing

pyiceberg:rest-catalog:v3.notes: REST Catalog fully supported for V3 tables

pyiceberg:unity-catalog:v2.notes: Unity Catalog can be accessed via its Iceberg REST API endpoint
caveats: Requires Unity Catalog Iceberg REST endpoint configuration
Not all Unity Catalog features are accessible via REST API

pyiceberg:unity-catalog:v3.notes: Unity Catalog accessible via REST API for V3 tables
caveats: Requires Unity Catalog Iceberg REST endpoint configuration

pyiceberg:variant-type:v2.notes: Variant type is a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:variant-type:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not yet support the Variant type
caveats: Not yet implemented

pyiceberg:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded variant is a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:shredded-variant:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not yet support shredded variant
caveats: Not yet implemented

pyiceberg:geometry-type:v2.notes: Geometry type is a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:geometry-type:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not yet support geometry types
caveats: Not yet implemented

pyiceberg:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond timestamps are a V3 feature not applicable to V2

pyiceberg:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: PyIceberg supports timestamp_ns and timestamptz_ns types (added in v0.10.0)

pyiceberg:lineage:v2.notes: Lineage tracking is not supported by PyIceberg

pyiceberg:lineage:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Measured on PyIceberg 0.12.0 (the current release): creating a V3 table raises NotImplementedError ("Writing V3 is not yet supported"), so it cannot assign row IDs on commit. It parses V3 row-lineage metadata (next-row-id, snapshot first-row-id) from tables written by other engines, but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: parses V3 row-lineage metadata written by other engines
Writing V3 is not yet supported (NotImplementedError on table creation, 0.12.0)

pyiceberg:statistics:v2.notes: PyIceberg reads column statistics from manifest files for scan planning and file pruning. Writes column statistics (min/max, null counts, value counts) when appending or overwriting data. Statistics mode configurable via write.metadata.metrics.default and per-column properties.

pyiceberg:statistics:v3.notes: Reads column statistics from V3 manifests for scan planning and file pruning; cannot write V3 manifests.
caveats: Read-only on V3 tables; V3 data writes are not yet supported (apache/iceberg-python#1551)

pyiceberg:bloom-filters:v2.notes: PyIceberg does not support reading or writing Parquet-level bloom filters or Puffin-based bloom filter statistics. PyIceberg uses PyArrow for Parquet writing which does not currently respect Iceberg bloom filter table properties.
caveats: PyArrow-based Parquet writer does not support Iceberg bloom filter table properties

pyiceberg:bloom-filters:v3.notes: PyIceberg does not support bloom filters for V3 tables
caveats: PyArrow-based Parquet writer does not support bloom filter configuration

pyiceberg:type-promotion:v2.notes: PyIceberg supports type promotion via the update_schema() context manager's update_column() method. Supports all Iceberg spec-defined promotions: int to long, float to double, and increasing decimal precision. The operation is metadata-only.

pyiceberg:type-promotion:v3.notes: Metadata-only type promotion via update_schema() works against REST catalogs, but fails on non-REST catalogs where TableMetadataV3.model_dump_json() raises NotImplementedError.
caveats: REST catalog only; client-side catalogs raise NotImplementedError when writing V3 metadata

pyiceberg:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v2.notes: PyIceberg has first-class REST catalog support. Configure with type=rest and the Horizon Catalog endpoint in pyiceberg config.

pyiceberg:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v3.notes: PyIceberg REST catalog support is available; V3 feature support depends on PyIceberg version (0.8.0+ recommended).
caveats: Requires PyIceberg 0.8.0+ for V3 table support

pyiceberg:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature; not applicable to Iceberg V2

pyiceberg:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Measured on PyIceberg 0.12.0 (the current release): creating a V3 table raises NotImplementedError ("Writing V3 is not yet supported"), so it cannot write deletion vectors. It can read V3 deletion vectors (added in 0.10.0) written by other engines, but that is a read capability, not this operation.
caveats: Read capability: reads V3 deletion vectors (0.10.0+)
Writing V3 is not yet supported (NotImplementedError on table creation, 0.12.0)

pyiceberg:unknown-type:v2.notes: Unknown type is a V3 feature, not available in format version 2

pyiceberg:unknown-type:v3.notes: Measured (PyIceberg 0.11.1): UnknownType is modelled, and a V3 table with a Spark-written VOID (unknown) column loads through the REST catalog and scans with the column null.
caveats: Creating a V3 table with PyIceberg itself is blocked by the general lack of V3 write support (apache/iceberg-python#1551); the read path is what was measured

pyiceberg:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: Google Lakehouse exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog, and this engine speaks the Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, so it can attach to the Google Lakehouse runtime catalog and read/write its tables like any other IRC endpoint. Rated partial because this specific pairing has not been measured end to end and Google-side specifics (credential vending, v3 preview) may vary.
caveats: Inferred from generic Iceberg REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse specifically

pyiceberg:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: Google Lakehouse exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog, and this engine speaks the Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, so it can attach to the Google Lakehouse runtime catalog and read/write its tables like any other IRC endpoint. Rated partial because this specific pairing has not been measured end to end and Google-side specifics (credential vending, v3 preview) may vary.
caveats: Inferred from generic Iceberg REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse specifically
